facts.fact: Targeting defines the context in which ads appear on Amazon
facts.quote: Targeting is the way you define the context in which you want your ads to appear

facts.fact: Customer shopping queries are words and phrases Amazon customers use to look for products
facts.quote: Customer shopping queries : words and phrases that Amazon customers use to look for products

facts.fact: Keywords are word combinations advertisers bid on in manual campaigns to match customer shopping queries
facts.quote: Keywords : word combinations that you bid on in manual campaigns to match customers' shopping queries

facts.fact: Sponsored Products offers three targeting options: Automatic, Manual, and Negative targeting
facts.quote: you have three targeting options – Automatic targeting Manual targeting Negative targeting

facts.fact: Automatic targeting matches ads to keywords and products similar to the advertised product based on shopping queries and product information
facts.quote: With automatic targeting your ad is automatically matched with keywords and products that are similar to the product you're advertising

facts.fact: Automatic targeting uses four default strategies: Close match, Loose match, Substitutes, and Complements
facts.quote: There are four automatic targeting strategies: Close match Loose match Substitutes Complements

facts.fact: Close match automatic targeting shows ads to shoppers using search terms closely related to the advertised product
facts.quote: We may show your ad to shoppers who use search terms closely related to your products

facts.fact: Loose match automatic targeting shows ads to shoppers using search terms loosely related to the advertised product
facts.quote: We may show your ad to shoppers who use search terms loosely related to your products

facts.fact: Substitutes automatic targeting shows ads on detail pages of products similar to the advertised product
facts.quote: We may show your ad to shoppers browsing detail pages of products similar to yours

facts.fact: Complements automatic targeting shows ads on detail pages of products that complement the advertised product
facts.quote: We may show your ad to shoppers who view the detail pages of products that complement your product

facts.fact: Automatic targeting campaigns can set a single default bid or set bids by targeting group
facts.quote: You can set a single default bid in your automatic campaign, or set bids by targeting group

facts.fact: Amazon recommends using dynamic bidding up and down for automatic targeting to maximize performance
facts.quote: We recommend using dynamic bidding up and down to help maximize performance

facts.fact: Dynamic down only bidding strategy can optimize automatic targeting based on ROAS
facts.quote: try a dynamic down only strategy to optimize based on return on ad spend (ROAS)

facts.fact: Amazon recommends letting automatic targeting campaigns run for about two weeks before creating manual campaigns
facts.quote: We recommend that you let your automatic campaign run for about two weeks before creating a manual campaign

facts.fact: Manual targeting allows advertisers to manually select which keywords or products to target
facts.quote: With manual targeting, you can manually select which keywords or products you want to target

facts.fact: Keyword targeting allows choosing specific keywords to help products appear in shopping results and on product detail pages
facts.quote: Keyword targeting allows you to choose specific keywords to add to your campaign

facts.fact: Amazon provides keyword recommendations and suggested bids to help with keyword selection
facts.quote: we provide keyword recommendations, along with suggested bids

facts.fact: Keyword recommendations are based on past keyword performance and search terms that translate into sales
facts.quote: we assess which keywords performed well for you in the past, as well as those which performed well across Amazon more broadly

facts.fact: Keyword match types control which search terms ads will be eligible to show against
facts.quote: Match types are used as a way to control your targeting, helping to fine-tune which search terms your ads will be eligible to show against

facts.fact: Sponsored Products offers three keyword match types: Broad match, Phrase match, and Exact match
facts.quote: The three match types for keyword targeting are: Broad match Phrase match Exact match

facts.fact: Broad match offers ads broad exposure to customer shopping queries including synonyms and related terms
facts.quote: This match type offers your ad broad exposure to customers' shopping queries

facts.fact: Broad match can include singulars, plurals, variations, synonyms, and related terms based on keyword meaning
facts.quote: It may include singulars, plurals, variations, synonyms, and related terms

facts.fact: Phrase match is more restrictive than broad match and requires all keyword components in the same order
facts.quote: This match type is more restrictive than broad match

facts.fact: Phrase match includes the plural form of the keyword
facts.quote: Phrase match also includes the plural form of the keyword

facts.fact: Exact match is the most restrictive match type and matches search terms word for word in the same order
facts.quote: This match is the most restrictive match type

facts.fact: Exact match tends to result in the highest conversion rates
facts.quote: tends to result in the highest conversion rates

facts.fact: Keywords are not case-sensitive and will match uppercase or lowercase letters
facts.quote: Keywords aren't case-sensitive, so we will match uppercase or lowercase letters in search terms

facts.fact: Keywords have a maximum limit of 10 words per keyword and 80 characters
facts.quote: There is a maximum limit of 10 words per keyword and 80 characters

facts.fact: Keywords can contain letters, numbers, or spaces but not special characters like question marks or slashes
facts.quote: Keywords can contain letters, numbers, or spaces. Other special characters such as a question mark, slash, double quote, ampersand or backlash are not permitted

facts.fact: Amazon recommends testing all three keyword match types with different bids to maximize performance
facts.quote: Test all three match types , with different bids, to help maximize your campaign performance

facts.fact: Amazon recommends setting the highest bid on exact match, lower on phrase match, and lowest on broad match
facts.quote: setting the highest bid on the exact match, a lower on the phrase match, and the lowest bid on the broad match

facts.fact: Branded keywords are directly associated with a brand or a brand being sold
facts.quote: Branded keywords are directly associated with your brand or a brand you sell

facts.fact: Bidding on branded keywords can be used as a brand defense strategy since competitors may bid on your branded keywords
facts.quote: Consider bidding on your branded keyword as a brand defense strategy since your competitors may be bidding on your branded keywords, too

facts.fact: Category keywords are non-branded keywords that relate to any product or category
facts.quote: Category keywords are non-branded (generic) keywords that relate to any product or category

facts.fact: Short-tail category keywords have 1-3 words while long-tail keywords have three or more words
facts.quote: They can be short-tail (i.e. 1-3 words such as women's running shoes) or long-tail

facts.fact: Product targeting allows targeting specific products, categories, brands, or other product features
facts.quote: Product targeting is a type of manual targeting that allows you to target specific products, categories, brands, or other product features

facts.fact: Product targeting ads are eligible for impressions on product detail pages and search result pages
facts.quote: your ad will be eligible for impressions on its product detail page, as well as search result pages

facts.fact: Product targeting can use metrics from auto campaigns, suggested targets, or category targeting
facts.quote: Use metrics from auto targeting campaigns Use suggested targets Start with category targeting

facts.fact: ASINs are always 10 characters long and are either entirely numeric or start with a B
facts.quote: An ASIN is always 10 characters long, and either entirely numeric (e.g. 0015366456) or starts with a B

facts.fact: Negative targeting helps exclude keywords, products, or brands to optimize campaign performance and spend
facts.quote: Negative targeting helps you exclude the keywords, products or brands you don't want your ads associated with, to help optimize your campaign's performance and spend

facts.fact: Negative keywords can help improve CTR, ROAS, and CPC metrics
facts.quote: This extra level of control can help improve your ad performance metrics, such as click-through rate (CTR), return on ad spend (ROAS) and cost per click (CPC)

facts.fact: Negative phrase match prevents ads from showing on shopping queries containing the complete phrase or close variations
facts.quote: Negative phrase : ads won't show on shopping queries that contain the complete phrase or close variations

facts.fact: Negative exact match prevents ads from showing on shopping queries containing the exact phrase or close variations
facts.quote: Negative exact : ads won't show on shopping queries that contain the exact phrase or close variation

facts.fact: Amazon recommends evaluating keyword performance after at least 20 clicks before adding as negative target
facts.quote: we recommend evaluating its performance after it has received at least 20 clicks

facts.fact: Amazon recommends letting negative keywords run for two weeks or more before making strategy changes
facts.quote: let your negative keywords run for two weeks or more, before making any changes to your strategy

facts.fact: Campaign targeting strategy cannot be changed once a campaign is live
facts.quote: Once the campaign is live, you will not be able to change the campaign targeting

facts.fact: Ad groups can contain a maximum of 1,000 products
facts.quote: You can add a maximum 1,000 products per ad group

facts.fact: Amazon recommends avoiding mixing different targeting strategies within the same campaign and ad group
facts.quote: We recommend that you avoid mixing different targeting strategies within the same campaign and ad group

facts.fact: Amazon recommends establishing benchmarks based on goals and historical campaign performance
facts.quote: You should establish benchmarks based on your goals and the historical performance of your campaigns

facts.fact: Six campaign strategies include: Expand, Promote, Protect, Conquest, Upsell, and Cross-sell
facts.quote: Expand : focus on high-traffic category keywords and products Promote : create a specific campaign to drive sales of products with coupons

facts.fact: Amazon recommends an always-on approach with evergreen campaigns
facts.quote: Consider having evergreen campaigns to always allow your ads to have a chance to be seen by shoppers

facts.fact: Amazon recommends starting small with one targeting type and testing different targeting types
facts.quote: consider starting with one targeting type – automatic or manual
